questions.q:
Two successive percentage decrease of 25% each is by what percentage less than two successive percentage increase of 25% each? (Round to two decimal places.)

25% की दो क्रमिक प्रतिशत कमी, 25% की दो क्रमिक प्रतिशत वृद्धि से कितने प्रतिशत कम है? (दशमलव के बाद दो स्थानों तक पूर्णांकित करें।)
questions.s:
Assume original value = 100.

After two 25% decreases: 100 → 75 → 56.25

After two 25% increases: 100 → 125 → 156.25

Net change difference = 156.25 - 56.25 = 100

Relative difference = (12.5/56.25) X 100 ≈ 22.22%

Option (c) is the correct answer.

questions_hin.q_hi: Swastik saves 20% of his income while spends the remaining amount on food, rent, education and shopping. 15% of the income is spent on food, while ₹12,800 is spent on rent, ₹32,000 on education and ₹7,200 on shopping. The amount spent on shopping is 11.25% of the total expenditure. How much money [in ₹] is spent on food?
o_hi: 9600
10800
12000
15000
questions_hin.s_hi:
Solution

Total income = 100x
Savings = 20x
Remaining = 80x
Food = 15x
New left = 65x
% salary on shopping =80x×11.25%=9x
9x→7200
Total salary = ₹80000
Money spent on food = = ₹12000
